name: Error State
description: Section-level failure with retry and report actions. Same shape as the empty state, danger tone, no alarm styling.
html:
Could not load deployments

The API returned 503 twice. Nothing was changed. Try again, or send the request id to support.

variants.name: Inline row
variants.description: The centred block becomes one alert row, icon then message then retry, sitting directly above the region that failed.
variants.guidance: Use when part of the page loaded and part did not: the table is there, the chart is not. The alert carries one uniform hairline border and a tinted surface, never a thick coloured stripe down its left edge, which is the 2012 alert tell law 3 names. It is announced with role alert because it appears without the reader asking, and the retry sits inside the row so the fix is where the failure is.
variants.html: Could not load deployments. The API returned 503 twice. Nothing was changed.

variants.name: Full page
variants.description: The block centres in the full viewport height and gains the request id in mono type between the message and the two actions.
variants.guidance: Use when nothing on the route loaded and there is no surviving interface to sit inside, which is the only case that earns a whole screen. The request id is the thing support will ask for, so it belongs on the screen in mono type rather than in a console log the reader cannot reach. Keep both actions: retry for the common case, copy the id for the one where retrying will not help.
